purpose: Teach: 明後日/ソファー/身の回り/空腹/憶え/定か/あこがれ/わが家

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、明後日お店休むのよ
lines.en: Sho, Mei's taking the day after tomorrow off from the shop.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact. Soft opening. Speaking more to herself than at him, but includes him in the moment. Warm, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんちのソファーが大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love Grandpa's sofa.
lines.style: Bright, immediate attention-grab. Small voice but unselfconscious. Direct eye contact seeking. The kind of non-sequitur only a six-year-old can pull off with complete seriousness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、身の回りのお片づけ、上手になったね
lines.en: You know, you've gotten so much better at keeping your things tidy.
lines.style: Warm noticing. Light, genuine praise — not performative. Speaks as someone who's watched him grow. Soft smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お昼ご飯前で空腹だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my stomach's rumbling — it's not lunchtime yet.
lines.style: Small complaint with no real edge. Matter-of-fact observation about his own body. Slight whine at the end, but without demanding anything. Almost confiding.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、お祖母ちゃんのお話、憶えてるよ
lines.en: You know, I still remember that story Grandma told us.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. Soft focus, like she's turning something over in her mind. Speaking partly to him, partly to herself. Slight pause before speaking, as if reaching back.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくのお祖父ちゃんの誕生日、定かじゃない
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm not really sure when Grandpa's birthday is.
lines.style: Honest uncertainty. No shame in not knowing. Small, unguarded voice. Matter-of-fact admission, like he's thinking out loud. Seeking reassurance, not judgment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 翔くん、ぼく、お父さんにあこがれてるよ
lines.en: I really look up to my dad.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. No performance. Deep admiration without self-consciousness. Speaks it simply, the way kids do when they mean something completely. Slight softness at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、わが家にはお祖父ちゃんと一緒に過ごす時間が大切だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, the time we spend together with Grandpa at home — that's what matters most.
lines.style: Small but certain. Speaks with the wisdom six-year-olds sometimes have. Unhurried. Each word deliberate. Soft, grounded tone — he knows this to be true.
